name: No Transit Tasks
teaser: I'm a one map kind of guy.
description_html:
No Transit Tasks

This is a fairly simple mod. Removes transit requirements from stock Tarkov tasks and adjusts those tasks to be doable without said transit.

Why? Transits are buggy (or disabled on Fika) so these tasks are at best hard to complete or at worst impossible to complete.

Install

Drag it into your SPT install.

Known Issues

FIXED The task step text will still say “Complete in one raid” or something similar. This can be ignored. I might fix this for English eventually, I might not.

Planned Features

Make it dynamically handle custom tasks and maybe fix the task condition text
